goal: Explain to a judge panel in ~10 minutes why vibe coding broke down and how the Agentic Knowledge Vault (base/) framework turns skills + micro-workflows + typed knowledge into durable, executable context.

deck_context.source_summary: Generic Agentic Obsidian Vault framework at ServiceBusWorkspace/base. Converts scattered raw notes into structured, typed knowledge via a 12-skill agent pipeline with human approval gates. Service Bus vault is the proof instance, not the product pitch.
deck_context.core_claim: A knowledge base alone is a book. Skills + micro-workflows + typed knowledge create a matured architect that can execute long-horizon work without re-explaining context every time.
deck_context.pipeline_steps: Intake → Classify → Retrieve → Plan → Generate → Link → Tag → Validate → Summarize
deck_context.architecture_flow: Human/Source → 00-Inbox → Knowledge Orchestrator → Skill Pipeline → Structured Vault (10-Knowledge) → Knowledge Graph → Human + Agent Understanding
pain_points: Hard to grab context (scattered Confluence, human resources)
two_task_types: Understand the underlying structure of the existing product
Knowing that structure, execute tasks based on the given architecture
demo_beats: Ask a domain-relevant question against the vault
Ask for an improvement to the vault

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: parent-authored sample brief for slide 5 book-vs-architect metaphor
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: view/read generated sample image after GenerateImage; pass approved sample path as style-only reference in later jobs
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Subagents must use the same backend/tool/mode (GenerateImage generate); return a blocker if unavailable. Do not use Pillow/HTML/SVG/python-pptx.

style.name: 手绘技术解释风
style.visual_direction: clean English hand-drawn technical explainer, near-white paper background, thin sketch lines, light pencil hatching, small precise central diagram, restrained pastel markers, lots of whitespace, calm educational tone
style.color_palette: line soft graphite #2F3437; accents pale blue #BFD7F1, sage green #CFE2D1, light peach #F4C7B8, pale lavender #D8C7EF; background near-white #FCFBF7
style.typography: restrained handwritten English titles, short readable handwritten labels, sparse text, easy to inspect
style.texture_and_finish: paper sketch / light pencil hatching, calm article-illustration feel not messy whiteboard
style.deck_consistency: same palette, typography mood, icon language, texture, and airy density across all slides

approved_style_reference.fidelity: match style only; do not copy layout or content
